entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand I recently purchased.
Hi there, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Mike. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF77819-B.
Okay, Sarah, pulling that up now... VF77819-B. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered about 20 days ago. You'd like to return it?
Yes, that's correct. I'd like to send it back.
Okay, no problem. Let me just check the policy here... yep, I see you're well within the 90 days for a full refund. I can get a return label sent to the email on file right now.
Oh, that's great! So simple. Thank you so much.
You're very welcome. The email with the return label should be in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out and attach it to the box. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks again, Mike.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
